add_blacklist_record.doc: Adds a new record to a blacklist.

add_maps_to_rotation.doc: Add the given maps to the rotation, returns the game server response for each map

add_message_template.doc: Add a new message template and return the ID of the new record

add_vip.doc: Adds VIP status on the game server and adds or updates their PlayerVIP record.

clear_cache.doc: Clear every key in this servers Redis cache and return number of deleted keys

delete_blacklist.doc: Removes a blacklist alongside all of its records.

edit_message_template.doc: Add a new message template and return the ID of the new record

edit_player_account.doc: Update PlayerAccount fields for the given player_id. All fields can be updated, including setting them to null. Returns dict with account data and success message.

edit_player_soldier.doc: Update NULL fields only in PlayerSoldier for the given player_id. Does not overwrite any existing non-null values. Returns the updated soldier as dict or None if not found.

flag_player.doc: Adds a new flag to the specified player_id

get_all_message_templates.doc: Get all message templates by category

get_ban.doc: get all bans from player_id @param player_id: steam_id_64 or windows store ID of a user @return: a array of bans

get_blacklist.doc: Get a blacklist and its respective records.

get_broadcast_message.doc: Returns the current broadcast message if the cache is set

get_gamestate.doc: Returns player counts, team scores, remaining match time and current/next map

get_live_game_stats.doc: Return stats for the currently playing match

get_live_scoreboard.doc: Return stats for all currently connected players (stats are reset on disconnect, not match start)

get_logs.doc: Returns raw text logs from the game server with no parsing performed

get_message_template.doc: Return the message template for the specified record if it exists

get_message_templates.doc: Get all possible message type categories

get_next_map.doc: Return the next map in the rotation as determined by the gameserver through the gamestate command

get_round_time_remaining.doc: Returns the amount of time left in the round as seconds

get_slots.doc: Return the current number of connected players and max players allowed

get_team_objective_scores.doc: Returns the number of objectives held by the allied/axis team respectively

get_webhook_service_summary.doc: Return the overall status of the service

remove_perma_ban.doc: Remove a perma ban by ban log. Note that a player ID is a valid ban log.

remove_temp_ban.doc: Remove a temp ban by player ID or game server ban log

remove_vip.doc: Removes VIP status on the game server and removes their PlayerVIP record.

reset_all_webhook_queues_for_server_numb.doc: Delete each queue associated with the specified server number

reset_webhook_message_type.doc: Delete each queue of wh_type (discord, etc.) returning the number of deleted queues

reset_webhook_queue.doc: Delete the specified queue; returning if it deleted any entries

reset_webhook_queue_type.doc: Delete each queue of wh_type (discord, etc.) returning the number of deleted queues

reset_webhook_queues.doc: Delete each queue; unprocessed messages may be lost depending on timing

set_broadcast.doc: Set the in game broadcast message and return the previous message if set

set_welcome_message.doc: Set the in game welcome (rules) message and return the previous message if set

unban.doc: Remove all temporary and permanent bans from the player_id.

unblacklist_player.doc: Expires all blacklists of a player and unbans them from all servers.

unflag_player.doc: Flags can be removed either by flag_id (database key) or by passing a player ID and flag
